name: playwright-android-demo
description: Playwright TypeScript automation with Allure, Android support, and GitHub Actions

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['allure-results', 'test-results'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) { fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true}); console.log('--- Cleaned: ' + d + ' ---'); } })"
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
